hints.title: Search Space Bounding
hints.text: With at most 8 cookie bags, each bag can be assigned to one of k children.

hints.title: Pruning Non-Optimal Branches
hints.text: If any child cookie count already exceeds the best known unfairness, abandon the branch immediately.

hints.title: Symmetry Breaking
hints.text: When assigning a bag to a child with zero cookies, subsequent empty children do not need separate exploration.

hints.title: Backtracking Cookie Allocation Implementation

variables: n: number of cookie bags (up to 8)
complexity.notes: Pruning and sorting bags in descending order reduces branch factor significantly.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Without symmetry breaking on empty children, duplicate distribution permutations are evaluated.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(k) array tracks allocated cookie counts per child.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate sorts descending to fail early and breaks on the first child with zero cookies.
